title: [Decision] Two client-side field-validation vocabularies, one job — retire `ValidationEngine`'s snake_case rules onto `buildValidationRules`, or keep both?
body:
Successor to **#6964**, filed by the objectstack triage seat (R+145) as option **D** of that card's fork. #6964 is closed: it asked for a reachability ban, and the measurement showed the maintainer had already ruled that file **outside** the ban. What survives is the question underneath, and it is a published-surface retirement — manual floor.

## The measured situation

`@object-ui/core` publishes **two** client-side field-validation vocabularies for one job:

| | vocabulary | consumers |
|:--|:--|--:|
| **live** | `buildValidationRules` → react-hook-form's compiled `rules` | 11 hits across 6 files |
| **dead** | `ValidationEngine` / `defaultValidationEngine` / `validateFields`, dispatching `min_length`, `max_length`, `email`, `url`, `phone`, `date_min`, `min_items`, `field_match`, `field_compare` | **0**, ever |

⭐ **Zero is not "currently unused" — it is "never used, once, in the repo's entire history."** `git log -S --all` over `packages` returns exactly **one** commit for `defaultValidationEngine` and one for `validateFields`: the commit that created them. Control `export class ValidationEngine` is lit at the same commit, so the zeros are readings.

And it is reachable public API by path: `packages/core/src/index.ts:15` → `validation/index.ts:18` → four named exports.

## Why #6964 could not answer it

That card's disposition was to extend the existing `#3110` reachability ban to cover this engine. Falsified before any code was written: `aebfa4fd0` — the commit that **created** the ban test — added, in the same commit, `packages/core/src/validation/index.ts:10-13`:

> The object-level rule ENGINE (`validators/`) is @deprecated (#3110) … **Field/record SHAPE validation (`schema-validator.js`, `validation-engine.js`) is unaffected: it is client-side form validation, not a mirror of a server rule.**

⇒ The author named this file and put it **outside** the decision, while it was already consumer-free. ⭐ The carve-out is about **kind**, not liveness — corroborated by its other member, `schema-validator.js`, being live in production today.

⇒ Banning it under the #3110 rationale would compile a claim that decision's own author denied, and would teach the next agent that **objectui bans client-side field validation** — false, and it would misroute work on the live `buildValidationRules` path. **A false rule is worse than no rule.**

## The fork

**A — retire it.** ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove: drop the four exports, delete the engine, and amend the `#3110` carve-out sentence so one record describes one decision.
**B — keep both**, and say in the carve-out why two vocabularies are wanted.

<!-- os-decision-facets -->

- **① 项目长远合理性(权重 ≥50%,领起推荐)** —— 一份工作两套词表,其中一套**从未被消费过一次**,而两者都在公开 barrel 上。这正是「声明即强制」要消灭的形状:一个消费者(人或 agent)读到 `validateFields` 会合理认为它是这个库做字段校验的方式,而真正的路径是 `buildValidationRules`。①指向 **A** —— 收窄到一套,而不是为并存写一段解释。⛔ 「留着并加注释」是把架构问题降级成散文问题。
- **② 实际业务拉动 —— 实测为零,且是最强的那种零**:不是「现在没人用」,是**仓库全部历史里从未被用过一次**,有点亮的对照。⇒ 按分歧推荐序,零拉动 ⇒ 荐不扩散;而这里「不扩散」的具体形态就是删除,因为它已经在公开面上了。⛔ 已发布零消费的能力不因沉没成本获得豁免。
- **③ 防 AI 犯错 —— 决定性。** 今天一个 agent 要给表单加校验,库里给它两条路,其中一条**接不上任何渲染器**:写完 `validateFields` 调用,表单行为不变,测试不红,没有任何信号。⇒ 这是「AI 写元数据/代码犯错而无反馈」的教科书形态。A 让错误路径在编译期消失;B 只能靠文档,而文档正是 #6964 证明了会被读反的东西。
- **④ 创业阶段不扩散** —— A 是删除,面变小;B 是承诺长期维护两套词表。④指向 **A**。

**推荐:A。** 四棱同向。⭐ 但它必须走 `Clause-②: yes` 与契约复审档位:删的是 `@object-ui/core` 的公开导出,是破坏性收窄,需要 changeset 明说。
**回退:B**,仅当维护者判断这套 snake_case 词表是要兑现的产品能力(例如给非 react-hook-form 的渲染器留的通用求值器)。若是,它需要的是**消费者**,不是注释。
**置信缺口:** ⛔ 未测量仓外是否有人从 `@object-ui/core` 导入这四个符号。这是已发布包,所以「零消费者」只对本仓成立。

## Implementation note, if A is ruled

⚠️ **Do not anchor any pattern on the bare token `validate`.** It is a live react-hook-form rule **key** written by `buildValidationRules` (`rules.validate = { … }`, `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`), and `validateSchema` / `assertValidSchema` / `validateBaseSchema` are live production identifiers in the same package tree. Anchor on the module path or the qualified symbols.

⚠️ Amend the `#3110` carve-out sentence in the same change. Leaving it would produce two contradictory records of one decision in one directory — the exact failure `#3110` was filed to fix.

Refs: #6964 (closed; the measurement and the falsified premise) · objectui `aebfa4fd0` (#3110 / #3111) · `packages/core/src/validation/index.ts:10-13`.
